parrafo_1.es: Este food truck opera en el Eastgate Shopping Center sobre Palm Beach Blvd, en Fort Myers. Tacos de asada, al pastor, pollo, chorizo y lengua, servidos en tortilla de maíz con cebolla y cilantro.
parrafo_1.en: This food truck operates at the Eastgate Shopping Center on Palm Beach Blvd in Fort Myers. Asada, al pastor, chicken, chorizo and tongue tacos, served on corn tortillas with onion and cilantro.

parrafo_2.es: También preparan tortas, quesadillas y aguas frescas de fruta natural, como la de piña que varios clientes piden junto con sus tacos.
parrafo_2.en: They also make tortas, quesadillas and fresh fruit aguas frescas, like the pineapple one several customers order alongside their tacos.

texto.es: Estamos en el Eastgate Shopping Center, sobre Palm Beach Blvd en Fort Myers. Abrimos todos los días de 10:30 AM a medianoche.
texto.en: We're at the Eastgate Shopping Center on Palm Beach Blvd in Fort Myers. Open every day from 10:30 AM to midnight.

texto.es: Asada, al pastor, pollo, chorizo o lengua. También tortas y quesadillas.
texto.en: Asada, al pastor, chicken, chorizo or tongue. Tortas and quesadillas too.

texto.es: Cada orden se hace al momento, con cebolla, cilantro y tu salsa favorita.
texto.en: Every order is made fresh, with onion, cilantro and your favorite salsa.

texto.es: Hay mesas afuera del truck. Pide también un agua fresca de piña para acompañar.
texto.en: There are picnic tables outside the truck. Grab a pineapple agua fresca to go with it.

items.quote: Excellent tacos. Ordered 4 different types and all were great. Agua Fresca delicious. Love the grilled jalapeños

I have only good things to say about this taco truck. Pork and chicken tacos are a dollar. You can get yourself 5 tacos and an aqua fresca for $10. You can't beat that. I'm not ashamed to admit that I eat here at least once a week and everytime the tacos are perfect. Ditch Taco Bell and instead support your local community.
Food is amazing. $2 tacos and $6 quesadillas. Good vibes too, will definitely keep going here!
